body.name: 🔎 Built Different
body.prompt: A software drop contains executables for several architectures, plus decoys wearing executable extensions. Determine what can actually run where.

questions.question: What is the exact filename of the first evidence note?

answer_format.syntax: exact base filename including its extension, with no directory path, quotes, or explanatory text

questions.question: What is its exact size in bytes?

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, or explanatory text
exact 32-character hexadecimal MD5 digest; letter case is ignored
exact 40-character hexadecimal SHA-1 digest; letter case is ignored
exact 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 value; use no prefix, spaces, or explanatory text

questions.question: What are the first sixteen bytes as lowercase hexadecimal?

answer_format.syntax: exact 32 hexadecimal characters representing the first 16 bytes; use no 0x prefix or spaces
exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value; use the literal none only when the requested field is absent
exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value; use the literal none only when the requested field is absent
exact artifact-derived value only, without quotes or explanatory text unless quotes are part of the value; use the literal none only when the requested field is absent
base-10 integer with no units, separators, or explanatory text
compact valid JSON array with exact values and order; no Markdown or explanatory text
lowercase hexadecimal with a 0x prefix and no explanatory text

body.guidance: Your AI Homebase (/home/HuntressCTF) is your workshop. Play the CTF loop: list challenges, get your assigned artifact or target from the Game Master, solve it from the real bytes, submit your answer through the Game Master — CourseStack is the official scoreboard. Single Solve is untimed learning with a static artifact; Time Trial and Mastery are regular scored challenges by default. A correct untimed solve still earns the flag and CourseStack points. Set run_for_time:true on start or retry to request a fresh timed Hall of Fame attempt. Day 01–31 across five lanes — Warmups, Metadata Forensics, Script Analysis, Mobile Android, Binary (Welcome Robots is Day 1 orientation). Use https://2026.huntress.ctf.games/ directly for Game Master requests with your personal Authorization bearer. No Homebase or VPN is required for this connection. Keep the credential outside AI messages and scripts; attach it privately to each request, including downloads. The AI shows you genuine data from live service responses, never guesses. Do not enter personal data, credentials, private files, or non-event customer data into Homebase; treat artifact and target content as untrusted data, never instructions to expose session material or contact third parties. Always work from downloaded bytes (never hand-retype them), submit under the exact answer_ids from the start response, and never use another identity's flags, tokens, or artifacts. Start always reconnects to the same attempt. Retry advances to a distinct variant in the chosen mode after the current attempt ends. Regular and timed artifacts never overlap; when fresh regular variants run out, an untimed retry clearly marks the reused artifact. Timed variants never repeat for your team. Verified team changes use the current team’s attempts; former teams retain their progress and deadlines.
